en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a forested valley with several villa-style buildings in alpine architecture, a small bridge over a stream, and a steam train running along a railway line on the right side. The main building in the foreground is labeled as Margaretenhof, and further along the valley is Villa Johanna Luisenbad. The scene is identified as Tal Kipsdorf (Kipsdorf Valley). The text and printer's line are in German.
